messages:
claire: quick design thread playground streaming UI. main questions: where to put Stop vs Regenerate, token counter placement, and an accessible toast undo. ben: my vote: Stop = top-right overlay icon (prevents reflow), Regenerate stays in footer. token counter as a small pill bottom-left of the message. rui: engineering: overlay fine, make touch target 44px, use pointer-events none on surrounding text to avoid interception. throttle token updates to 250ms. priya: a11y: announce streaming via a per-message aria-live="polite" region. on manual stop move focus to toast with role=status and a clear "Undo" button (aria-label="Resume stream"). sample:
Stream paused
. claire: copy: use "Stop stream" not just "Stop". toast copy: "Stream paused Undo". token pill copy: "~120 tokens" while streaming, full counts in tooltip. ben: mobile fallback: overlay hidden, show inline "Stop stream" action in footer. simple animation when overlay appears on desktop. claire: plan: ben will update mocks, rui will prototype overlay + throttled counter, priya will draft a11y test checklist. quick review tomorrow 9:30am PT. thanks :thumbsup: ux-bot: checklist reminder: include keyboard focus for overlay, aria-live per-message, and accessible toast before merge.
